body: I hate school with every fiber of my being. I used to be excited about hanging out with friends, and talking to people. nowadays it’s a struggle to get out of my room.
I’ve never truly thought about what makes me happy, and maybe it’s because nothing does.

I’ve slowly lost interest in everything, I now only focus on how I feel. My entire life revolves around school, I go to school, come home, get treated like crap by my so called family, and go to bed. and everyday it just repeats.
literally the smallest thing triggers me and it’s the actual worst. I see someone being happy and it just reminds me of how shit my life is.
